BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents is delighted to present Apartment 113, Cedar Square to the Swords property market. Ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Ridgewood development, this attractive two-bedroom apartment offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking a well-connected home in a thriving residential location.

The accommodation is bright and well-proportioned throughout, featuring a spacious open-plan living and dining area with large windows that fill the space with natural light, alongside a practical, well-appointed kitchen. There are two generously sized double bedrooms and a modern family bathroom, providing comfortable and versatile living accommodation.

Apartment 113 enjoys an exceptionally convenient location with excellent connectivity to Swords and the surrounding areas. The development is adjacent to Forrest Little Golf Club and benefits from an excellent range of local amenities, including a Tesco Express, pharmacy with medical centre, and crèche, all within easy walking distance.

Swords Village is just minutes away, offering an extensive selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars, and leisure facilities, including the popular Pavilions Shopping Centre. The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with frequent bus services and the Swords Express providing access to Dublin City Centre in approximately 15 minutes.

Further enhancing its appeal, the property is within close proximity to Airside Business & Retail Park, Dublin Airport, and the M1 and M50 motorways, making it an ideal choice for commuters and frequent travellers alike.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, convenience, and excellent potential this superb apartment has to offer.
